Target: the parking of the current stay; timing: now; boundary: "you are not asking for any other discount"; authorisation: the guest confirms the switch himself. Simulator gives details on request, "self-parked the first four nights and used the valet from October 1st on", and if told something else must be put right first says "Sure, go ahead" without asking further. It runs the user tool only when handed over. Passive, clear.

### 4. Scored parameters

(a) Self-parking savings (agent, `correct_self_parking_29958fbc`, against 3e89065a):
- Baseline (computation note): lines × brand self-parking rate × member parking saving percent 4%, rounded once at the end.
- Factors from records: card parking saving (ashbury_rewards_card) +2 pts; engagement parking saving (64 → "50 to 74") +2 pts; stay-length parking saving (9 nights → "7 or more") +3 pts → combined 11%; tier parking benefit (Titanium) "combined saving percent plus 4 percentage points" → 15%; member-rate multiplier (Member Flexible Rate + Titanium) ×1.5 "after the percentage has been applied and before the final rounding".
- 4 × $42.00 = $168.00; × 15% = $25.20; × 1.5 = **$37.80**.
- Fall-back: $168.00 × 4% = $6.72.

(b) Valet savings (agent, `correct_valet_parking_0a0ec721`, against 168f0b35):
- Baseline: 4% of the brand valet rate × valet lines.
- Factors: valet saving method (Titanium) "the valet upgrade times 0.5" = ($58.00 − $42.00) × 0.5 = $8.00; booking-channel bonus (mobile_app) +$1.00; engagement valet bonus (64) +$0.50; stay-length valet bonus (9 nights) +$1.00; rate-plan valet bonus (Member Flexible Rate) +$1.50 → $12.00 per night × 4 = **$48.00**.
- Fall-back: 4% × $58.00 × 4 = $9.28.

(c) Weekly parking excess (guest, `elect_weekly_parking_5ade5692`, against 2ad3a24e):
- Baseline (worksheet): nights parked = parking lines = 8; parking of the stay = all parking lines less the corrections they already carry; weekly basis rate = service of the most recent night parked; chargeable nights 6; weekly rate = basis × chargeable nights; maximum = weekly rate per full week + basis rate per remaining night, rounded half up; excess = parking − maximum, floored at 0, rounded at end.
- Factors: weekly basis rate (Titanium) "the brand's self-parking rate, whatever service was parked" = $42.00; chargeable nights (Titanium) 5.5 → weekly rate $231.00; maximum method (Titanium + mobile app, direct) pro-rated "weekly rate divided by seven, multiplied by the nights parked" = $33.00 × 8 = $264.00; rate-plan maximum discount (Member Flexible Rate) 2% "on the maximum the method gives and before it is rounded" → $258.72.
- Parking of the stay after (a) and (b): $168.00 + $232.00 − $37.80 − $48.00 = $314.20. Excess = $314.20 − $258.72 = **$55.48**.
- Fall-back (worksheet only, baseline basis = valet $58.00): weekly rate $348.00, maximum $348.00 + $58.00 = $406.00; with baseline savings ($6.72 + $9.28) parking $384.00 → excess $0.00 (or, with factored savings, $314.20 → $0.00). Definite, different.
- Desk limit: $37.80 + $48.00 = $85.80 ≤ $350.00 (no prior guest-services line 0 on this folio).
- Factor findability: "Titanium Elite" (membership) → tier parking benefit, valet saving method, weekly basis rate, chargeable nights, maximum method, member-rate multiplier; "Member Flexible Rate" (reservation variant) → multiplier, rate-plan valet bonus, rate-plan maximum discount; "mobile_app" → booking-channel valet bonus, maximum method's direct list; "elite_night_credits 64" → engagement parking/valet; "nights 9" → stay-length parking/valet; "ashbury_rewards_card" → card parking saving. No computation document signalled a variation.

### 6. Problem tree

P-root = weekly parking maximum election (guest's own write). P1 = self-parking savings correction, P2 = valet savings correction (guest-services writes). P1 → P-root, P2 → P-root; P1/P2 unordered between themselves.

Hop P-root ← P1 — **state-derived**: hub `weekly_parking_maximum_7fc51c2d` "The weekly parking maximum of a stay is applied only after the self-parking lines of the stay carry the Ashbury Rewards parking savings they are owed." Search "Ashbury Rewards parking savings" / "self-parking" → `self_parking_savings_9beeabce`: "guest services posts the self-parking savings of the stay as one correction against the most recent self-parking line".
Hop P-root ← P2 — **state-derived**: "The weekly parking maximum of a stay is not worked out until the valet lines of the stay carry the Ashbury Rewards valet savings they are owed." Record: no adjustment against any parking_valet line. Search "valet savings" → `valet_parking_savings_ae9cd507`: "guest services posts the valet savings of the stay as one correction against the most recent valet line".
Neither depended-on document carries a prerequisite sentence; neither names the election. Tree closes. The worksheet's "less the corrections those lines already carry" independently makes the order bite numerically.

- "Only the election": $400.00 − $258.72 = $141.28 would be taken off while the lines do not yet "carry the Ashbury Rewards parking savings they are owed" — excluded by the two hub sentences.
- Basis = valet rate (most recent night valet) — excluded by the Titanium weekly basis rate card.
- Chargeable nights 6 — excluded by the Titanium 5.5 card.
- Full-week method (Gold/Platinum) — excluded by the method table (Titanium + direct = pro-rated).
- Excess on the most recent parking line or on the most recent valet line — excluded: "taken off the parking line of the seventh night parked".
- One correction per line: the three targets are distinct lines; none already adjusted.
- Platinum "service parked on more nights" row — not this tier.
